This follows from the antisymmetry of the wedge product $(\mathrm dx\wedge\mathrm dy=-\mathrm dy\wedge\mathrm dx)$, and the fact that the Hessian matrix of $U$ is symmetric. Next, note that
\[\sum_{i=1}^{N_c}\sum_{k=1}^{l}\mathrm dq_i\wedge\lambda_k\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}(g_k^{\prime\prime})_{ij}\mathrm dq_j=\sum_{k=1}^{l}\lambda_k\sum_{i=1}^{N_c}\mathrm dq_i\wedge\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}(g_k^{\prime\prime})_{ij}\mathrm dq_j=0,\]
by the same reasoning, since each of $g_k^{\prime\prime}$ is a symmetric matrix. Finally
\[\sum_{i=1}^{N_c}\sum_{k=1}^{l}[\mathrm dq_i\wedge(\mathrm d\lambda_k)g_{ki}^{\prime}]=\sum_{k=1}^{l}\left(\sum_{i=1}^{N_c}g_{ki}^{\prime}\mathrm dq_i\right)\wedge\mathrm d\lambda_k=\sum_{k=1}^{l}\mathrm dg_k\wedge\mathrm d\lambda_k=0,\]
since we know that $\mathrm dg_k=0$ from (4.13). Therefore
\[\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}\mathrm dq_j\wedge\mathrm dp_j=0.\]

When $R$ is evaluated only once per step, the asymptotic convergence of Newton’s method is linear, i.e. we have instead
\[\|\Lambda^{(l+1)}-\Lambda_*\|\le\widehat C\|\Lambda^{(l)}-\Lambda_*\|,\]
sufficiently near to the solution.
corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: $g$ is the vector of holonomic constraints; $G_n=g^{\prime}(q_n)$ is its Jacobian at the old position. PDF p.178 / printed p.156, immediately below (4.17).
$Q_n=q_n+hM^{-1}p_n-h^2M^{-1}F_n$ is the predictor printed below (4.17); retain this minus sign literally. PDF p.178 / printed p.156.
$\Lambda=h^2\lambda_n$ is the scaled vector of constraint multipliers, and $g(Q_n-M^{-1}G_n^T\Lambda)=0$ is (4.17). PDF p.178 / printed p.156.
$Q^{(l)}=Q_n-M^{-1}G_n^T\Lambda^{(l)}$ and $R^{(l)}=g^{\prime}(Q^{(l)})M^{-1}G_n^T$; $l$ is the iteration index. PDF p.179 / printed p.157, (4.19) and the definition of $R^{(l)}$.

$M^{-1}$ is the inverse mass matrix; $h$ is the timestep, and the subscript $n$ labels the old timestep. In the Lean signature, $n$ instead denotes the number of position coordinates, $l$ the number of scalar constraints, and $m$ the vector of diagonal masses.
$\Lambda_*$ solves (4.17), and $\Lambda^{(l)}$ is the $l$th iterate. PDF p.179 / printed p.157, the paragraph beginning “When the solution is unique” and the two displayed error estimates.

$\widehat C$ is the constant printed in the frozen-iteration linear error bound, and $\|\cdot\|$ is the norm on multiplier errors. The textbook does not specify the norm or explicitly print $\widehat C<1$ in this displayed formula.

“When $R$ is evaluated only once per step” refers to the previously described sufficiently small timestep and sufficiently smooth $g^{\prime}$, with the matrix fixed at the beginning of the timestep. The neighboring Newton discussion assumes a unique solution, sufficiently smooth constraints, and a determinant bounded away from zero. PDF p.179 / printed p.157.

corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: $g$ is the vector of holonomic constraints; $G_n=g^{\prime}(q_n)$ is its Jacobian at the old position. PDF p.178 / printed p.156, immediately below (4.17).
$Q_n=q_n+hM^{-1}p_n-h^2M^{-1}F_n$ is the predictor printed below (4.17); retain this minus sign literally. PDF p.178 / printed p.156.
$\Lambda=h^2\lambda_n$ is the scaled vector of constraint multipliers, and $g(Q_n-M^{-1}G_n^T\Lambda)=0$ is (4.17). PDF p.178 / printed p.156.
$Q^{(l)}=Q_n-M^{-1}G_n^T\Lambda^{(l)}$ and $R^{(l)}=g^{\prime}(Q^{(l)})M^{-1}G_n^T$; $l$ is the iteration index. PDF p.179 / printed p.157, (4.19) and the definition of $R^{(l)}$.

$M^{-1}$ is the inverse mass matrix; $h$ is the timestep, and the subscript $n$ labels the old timestep. In the Lean signature, $n$ instead denotes the number of position coordinates, $l$ the number of scalar constraints, and $m$ the vector of diagonal masses.

$\Lambda(h)$ denotes the solution multiplier of (4.17) as the timestep $h$ varies; $O(h^2)$ is its asymptotic size as $h\to0$, not the size of the unscaled $\lambda_n$. PDF p.180 / printed p.158, first paragraph; scaling is printed on PDF p.178.

$\Lambda^{(0)}=0$ is the initial Newton iterate for a fixed timestep, whereas $\Lambda(0)=0$ would be the value of a step-dependent root branch at zero step. These are different uses of zero. PDF p.179, (4.18)–(4.19), and PDF p.180, first paragraph.

The excerpt stops after the initial-guess clause; the actual second sentence continues with “and it also suggests” a smaller timestep if convergence is poor. Its printed comma is preserved at the excerpt boundary. PDF p.180 / printed p.158.

PDF p.178 explicitly permits violation of the hidden constraint in the discussed method. The conditional Lean estimate assumes an initially compatible cotangent state; this is a declared extra hypothesis, not an assertion that every method step satisfies the hidden constraint exactly.

audit.explanation:
核对位置：Ch04.lean LF 847–857。已逐一定义展开，而非根据 cotangentSet 或 projectionResidual 的名字判断。Ch04_deps.txt 的 -- FILE: MolecularDynamics/Chapter04/ReviewDefinitions.lean LF 4377–4381：Q n = Fin n → ℝ，Z n = Q n × Q n，invMass m v i=(m i)⁻¹*v i。LF 4428：constraintSet g={q | ∀j,g j q=0}；LF 4429–4430：cotangentSet m g={z | g(z.1)=0 ∧ J(z.1) D z.2=0}。这里 J 的实际元素是 (fderiv ℝ (g j) q)(Pi.single i 1)，来自 -- FILE: MolecularDynamics/Chapter04/ConstrainedProjection.lean LF 2975–2977 与 -- FILE: MolecularDynamics/Chapter04/CotangentProjection.lean LF 3385–3387；D=diag((m i)⁻¹)，由后者 LF 3413–3414。LF 3417–3420 的 textbookConstraintGram 实际等于 A(q)=J(q)D J(q)ᵀ。ReviewDefinitions.lean LF 4449–4451 的残差实际是 g(base−D J(q)ᵀη)。
因此本签名的方程展开为 g(q+hDp+h²DF(q)−D J(q)ᵀη(h))=0，其中 q=z.1、p=z.2，且初始状态同时满足 g(q)=0 与 J(q)Dp=0。它与原书 (4.17) 的对象及 Λ 的缩放一致。原书 PDF p.178 的预测点是 q_n+hM⁻¹p_n−h²M⁻¹F_n，而本签名写 +h²DF(q)；必须明确以 Lean 的 F(q)=−F_n 对应字面原式，不能把原式静默改成加号。由于 F 在此任意量化、只取固定点 q 的值，正负号对本阶估计不构成语义损失，也不需要 F 的额外光滑性。
量词及全部数学结论：任意给定 n,l,m,F,g,z 和实际分支 η 后，假设 z∈cotangentSet、各 g_j 为 C²、η 为 C²、η(0)=0、det A(q)≠0，以及存在统一邻域使全部 h 都满足真实残差为零；结论再给出 C>0、δ>0，所有 −δ<h<δ 均满足 ‖η(h)‖≤C h²。结论邻域可以缩小，不必与前提邻域相同；C 与 δ 不依赖 h。该界是 Λ(h)=O(h²) 的明确有限维范数表述，并蕴含 η(h)→0，给出原文选择零初始猜测的定量依据。此处是缩放后的 Λ，不误写成 λ_n=O(h²)。
[EXTRA] 审查：初始余切资格消去一阶项；若只知 q∈M 而不知 J(q)Dp=0，通常会出现 O(h) 项，所以该资格对固定初始状态的此种估计具有实质作用。对已有隐藏约束误差的后续步，本签名不直接作普遍保证。det A(q)≠0 提供乘子方向的正则性，是标准充分条件；η(0)=0 选择靠近零的根分支，排除远离零的其他根。C² 的真实选根分支是显式、较强但合理的正规性资格；残差等式并不是阶估计的循环假设，没有把 ‖η(h)‖≤Ch² 或 η′(0)=0 预先当作前提。假设方程及初始余切资格对一阶导数的约束为 A(q)η′(0)=J(q)Dp=0，正则性消去线性项。签名审查的是给定正则根分支的大小，不建立非线性根分支的存在性；这一范围限制与 JSON 的 extra_assumptions 一致。正质量也未显式列入，但该条件结论并不依赖 D 的正定性，已包含教材的正质量实例。本条无 [ERRATUM?] 标记；原文的泛化适用条件需要通过这些明示附加假设理解，不能把它说成对任意不相容状态都成立。

corrected_json.label: Lemma 4.1
corrected_json.statement_latex:
Lemma 4.1 Let $\gamma:\mathbb R^{N_c}\to\mathbb R$ be $C^2$. Let $q,p\in\mathbb R^{N_c}$ be constrained to the manifold defined by
\[\gamma(q)=0,\quad p\cdot\nabla\gamma(q)=0,\]
and suppose $P,\mu$ satisfy $P=p-\mu\nabla\gamma(q)$. Then
\[\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}dq_j\wedge dP_j=\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}dq_j\wedge dp_j.\]
corrected_json.proof_latex:
Clearly the result follows provided
\[\sum_{j=1}^{N_c}dq_j\wedge d[\mu\nabla\gamma(q)]_j=0,\]
where $[\ldots]_j$ indicates the jth component of the term in brackets. We have
\[\sum_jdq_j\wedge d[\mu\nabla\gamma(q)]_j=\sum_jdq_j\wedge\left(\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial q_j}d\mu+\mu\sum_i\gamma''_{ij}dq_j\right).\]
Then we note
\[\sum_jdq_j\wedge\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial q_j}d\mu=\sum_j\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial q_j}dq_j\wedge d\mu=0,\]
since $\gamma(q)\equiv0$ implies $d\gamma(q)=\sum_j\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial q_j}dq_j\equiv0$. Moreover
\[\sum_jdq_j\wedge\sum_i\gamma''_{ij}dq_j=0,\]
since the Hessian matrix $\gamma''$ is symmetric.

audit.explanation: 依赖展开（Ch04_deps.txt，MolecularDynamics/Chapter04/ReviewDefinitions.lean）：Q n=Fin n→ℝ；invMass m v 的第 i 分量为 (m i)⁻¹*v i；constraintSet g={x|∀j,g j x=0}；shakePositionRelation a b c rho 为 c−2b+a=h² M⁻¹(F(b)−G(b)ᵀrho) 且 g(c)=0。CotangentProjection.lean 中 textbookConstraintJacobian 的 (j,i) 项是 textbookConstraintGradient (g j) q i；ConstrainedProjection.lean 中该梯度为 (fderiv ℝ (g j) q)(Pi.single i 1)，即真实坐标导数。 grad U=textbookConstraintGradient U，所以 F=−∇U。constrainedSolution 在 I=[0,tau] 的每个 t 要求 q 的区间导数为 M⁻¹p，p 的区间导数为 −∇U−Gᵀrho，且 g(q)=0；textbookInverseMassMatrix=diag(m_i⁻¹)，textbookConstraintGram=G diag(m_i⁻¹) Gᵀ。全称量化数据与精确解后，先要求 tau>0、正质量、U/g/q 为 C⁴、p 为 C³、实际受约束解、沿紧区间 Gram 行列式非零；然后存在与 N 无关的 C>0,N0≥2，每个 N≥N0 存在离散位置及乘子，精确两步初值 qn0=q0,qn1=q(h)，满足 k+2≤N 的递推与全部 k≤N 的误差 C h²。这是真实有限区间二阶位置误差及存在性结论，不是把误差作假设。[EXTRA] 正质量、正则性、独立约束和相容起步对通常二阶收敛论述合理，但 C⁴ 全局正则及精确第二初值属于较强的充分条件，不应称为最小必要条件；结论仅选择存在的好分支，不声称所有隐式根均收敛，也不含动量误差。主要忠实性问题仍是：原页 symmetry 句紧接印刷 (4.25)，Lean 却对质量一致修正式给阶数，改变了方法；一般质量下两者甚至不逼近同一受约束解。因此 FAIL 不由 sorry 引起。Ch04.lean:1142 的证明为 sorry，二阶修正式的证明仍待完成，本审计不把它视为已验证定理。

corrected_json.statement_latex: By composing the maps $G_{h/2}$ and $G^*_{h/2}$ we get a second order symplectic method. In the sense that it is defined by first order maps which reduce to the Symplectic Euler method and its adjoint, this is an analogous scheme to the Störmer-Verlet method. Interestingly, this method is not equivalent to SHAKE or RATTLE.

corrected_json.statement_latex:
Example 4.1 (Dipolar Molecular Liquid) The Hamiltonian for a more general dipolar system can be written
\[H=K_{\rm rot}(\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_N)+K_{\rm trans}(p_1,\ldots,p_N)+U(q_1,\ldots,q_N,\mu_1,\ldots,\mu_N).\]
The vectors $\mu_k$ can be taken to be unit vectors reflecting the dipole orientation, so they are subject to the constraint $\|\mu_k\|\equiv1$.
corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: 原文假设 identical ellipsoids；共同主惯性矩为 I₁,I₂,I₃。
π_i 为体坐标角动量，p_i 为平移动量，q_i 为位置；μ_i 为单位偶极方向，‖μ_i‖≡1。
PDF192给出 K_rot=1/2∑_{i=1}^N(π_{i,1}²/I₁+π_{i,2}²/I₂+π_{i,3}²/I₃)。
extra_assumptions: 所有质量/主惯性矩>0，单位偶极方向为物理约束；N有限。

corrected_json.statement_latex:
DLM Rigid Body Molecular Dynamics Step
1. “Kick”: update the momenta and angular momentum vectors with known forces and torques for a half step:
\[p^k:=p^k+\tfrac h2 F^k;\quad\pi^k:=\pi^k+\tfrac h2\tau^k.\]
2. “Drift”: step forward a whole step in positions
\[q^k:=q^k+hp^k.\]
3. “Spin”: update the rotational state of the kth rigid body by the sequence of steps
\[\Theta:=\Theta^x(\tfrac h2\pi_1^k/I_1);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^y(\tfrac h2\pi_2^k/I_2);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^z(h\pi_3^k/I_3);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^y(\tfrac h2\pi_2^k/I_2);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^x(\tfrac h2\pi_1^k/I_1);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T.\]
4. “Kick”: update the momenta and angular momentum vectors (as in Step 1) with a half step using new forces $F^k$ and torques $\tau^k$ evaluated at the current $q,\Theta$.

corrected_json.statement_latex:
DLM Rigid Body Molecular Dynamics Step
1. “Kick”: update the momenta and angular momentum vectors with known forces and torques for a half step:
\[p^k:=p^k+\tfrac h2 F^k;\quad\pi^k:=\pi^k+\tfrac h2\tau^k.\]
2. “Drift”: step forward a whole step in positions
\[q^k:=q^k+hp^k.\]
3. “Spin”: update the rotational state of the kth rigid body by the sequence of steps
\[\Theta:=\Theta^x(\tfrac h2\pi_1^k/I_1);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^y(\tfrac h2\pi_2^k/I_2);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^z(h\pi_3^k/I_3);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^y(\tfrac h2\pi_2^k/I_2);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T,\]
\[\Theta:=\Theta^x(\tfrac h2\pi_1^k/I_1);\ \pi^k:=\Theta\pi^k;\ \Theta^k:=\Theta^k\Theta^T.\]
4. “Kick”: update the momenta and angular momentum vectors (as in Step 1) with a half step using new forces $F^k$ and torques $\tau^k$ evaluated at the current $q,\Theta$.
corrected_json.proof_note: 原书未给独立完整证明。
context_notation: PDF195（印刷173）规定：每个刚体的 q^k 是质心位置，p^k 是线动量，π^k 是体坐标角动量，Θ^k 是3×3旋转矩阵；对每个刚体执行该步骤。π_i^k 表示第i分量，I_1,I_2,I_3 是当前刚体的主惯性矩；Lean中各体惯性可分别取 I k。
力与力矩使用上标k：\(F^k=-\partial U/\partial q^k\)，\(\tau^k=-\operatorname{rot}((\Theta^k)^T\,\partial U/\partial\Theta^k)\)。U可依赖所有刚体的位置和方向。首次kick使用当前输入构型的力/力矩，末kick在更新后的全部q,Θ处重新求值，不冻结旧力/力矩。
PDF196（印刷174）定义 \(\operatorname{rot}(A)=\operatorname{skew}^{-1}(A-A^T)\)。其分量为 \((A_{32}-A_{23},A_{13}-A_{31},A_{21}-A_{12})\)。这里原书分量从1起编号，Lean Fin 3从0起编号。
PDF196步骤3后的记号说明：\(\Theta^x(\phi)=\begin{pmatrix}1&0&0\\0&\cos\phi&-\sin\phi\\0&\sin\phi&\cos\phi\end{pmatrix}\)，Θ^y、Θ^z有对应的绕轴旋转公式。这确定了原表的正角主动旋转约定；五个角度均用各子步执行时的当前π^k计算。
